task_label: Implement hidden routine candidate lifecycle and fail-closed guards
problem_statement: The approved feature requires a hidden routine-candidate phase before any visible saved routine exists, but the current routine/workflow stack only knows visible saved routines and offer logs. The first implementation slice must add an internal candidate lifecycle with fail-closed suitability guards and a 30-day expiry rule.

latest_user_evidence.actual: Spec 29 and TASK-SPEC29.1 are approved/prechecked, but no candidate lifecycle exists yet.
latest_user_evidence.expected: One qualifying successful multi-step workflow produces exactly one internal candidate; risky or context-heavy flows produce none; unconfirmed candidates expire after 30 days.

acceptance_criteria: Only allowlisted backend persistence/workflow files and focused tests may change.
A first qualifying successful multi-step workflow creates exactly one internal candidate instead of a visible saved routine.
Risky, sensitive, or strongly context-dependent workflows do not create candidates in v1.
Unconfirmed candidates expire after 30 days and are no longer treated as active learning candidates.
Do not add automatic promotion, passive chat transparency, settings UI, routines API, OAuth, transport changes, migrations, Git, or broad architecture changes.
cursor_prompt_contract: Use Cursor for one bounded execution patch. Inspect only allowlisted persistence/workflow files, implement the smallest safe hidden candidate lifecycle with 30-day expiry and fail-closed guards, run listed checks, and return concise JSON-compatible output.
